test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Ritu was still standing in the queue when the __film was starting__.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. film started .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence describes an action in the past ("Ritu was standing in the queue") when another action ("the film was starting") occurred. This is an example of the past continuous tense interrupted by the past simple tense.
 
• The correct tense for the second action is the past simple form ("film started").
 
• Option 4 ("film started") correctly conveys the sequence of events and maintains grammatical accuracy.

Correct sentence: *Ritu was still standing in the queue when the **film started**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Past Continuous Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + was/were + verb (-ing).
 
• **Example:** She was reading a book.
 
• **Usage:** Describes an ongoing action in the past.
 
 
 
• **Past Simple Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + past form of the verb.
 
• **Example:** The train arrived late.
 
• **Usage:** Describes a completed action in the past.
